description: Send one email. Use when the user wants an email sent from this project. Before: get_status for the sending mode; a from address on a verified domain (list_domains, which needs a full access key). Returns the email id and status, and replayed true when this idempotency_key was already used. Scope: mail:send. Reuse the same idempotency_key on retry: it is never sent twice. Cost: counted in the Galon Mail plan quota, never charged to the prepaid balance per email. next_action add_and_verify_domain: the from domain is not verified yet.

bcc.description: Blind copy recipients: one address or a list of up to 50.

cc.description: Copy recipients: one address or a list of up to 50.

from.description: Sender on a verified domain: hello@acme.com or Acme <hello@acme.com>.

html.description: HTML body. Give html, text or both, unless template.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per email (8-200 printable ASCII chars). Reuse it on retry.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 with time zone, at most 72 hours ahead. Omit to send now.

tags.description: Up to 10 name/value labels to find the email later (letters, digits, _ and -).

template.description: A published template instead of html and text.

id.description: Id or alias of a published template.

variables.description: Values of the template variables, by key.

text.description: Plain-text body. Give html, text or both, unless template.

to.description: Recipient email address, or a list of 1 to 50 addresses.

name: send_email
title: Send an email
